# Claude Code Agent Framework

> Specialized AI agent marketplace and template system for collaborative software engineering workflows

This framework provides a curated marketplace of production-ready Claude Code agents
and templates for creating custom agents. Each agent has specific expertise, tools,
and workflows optimized for their domain, enabling systematic and high-quality
software development.

## Agent Marketplace
- [Agent Catalog](./agents.json): Machine-readable catalog with metadata
- [Market Guide](./MARKET.md): Complete marketplace documentation
- 8 production-ready agents across 6 categories
- Categories: Development, Quality, Planning, Analysis, Product, Optimization

## Agent Definitions
- [Strategic Planner](./personas/strategic-planner.md): Requirements and design
- [Task Executor](./personas/task-executor.md): Precise implementation
- [Code Reviewer](./personas/code-reviewer.md): Quality assurance
- [Steering Architect](./personas/steering-architect.md): Project analysis
- [Debugger](./personas/debugger.md): Error resolution
- [Data Scientist](./personas/data-scientist.md): Data analysis
- [Product Manager](./personas/product-manager.md): PRD creation
- [LLMs.txt Generator](./personas/llms-txt-generator.md): Context optimization
